entry: Within this bounded synthetic case, workflow integration depended on explicit remediation ownership and exception handling more than on alert generation alone.
Triangulation across configuration snapshots, issue records, meeting notes, policy documents and illustrative interviews, including discrepant evidence.

Illustrative synthesis only: scanning became routine only after remediation ownership and exception handling were assigned. Alert volume alone did not explain uptake; one project bypassed the control when responsibility remained ambiguous.
